title: Conditional κ = 0.00312476680 (+5.8046936e-7 over #5811): unread path
body:
This construction raises **complete conditional κ to 0.00312476680**, a gain of **0.00000058046936 (0.01858%)** over [PR #5811](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5811). One register receives its two source contributions at the endpoint frames, so a paid rank-4/rank-1 path becomes one rank-5 query. The additional scalar ADD is charged. This is a small improvement; the donor's large-improvement objective remains unmet.

[Proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/05cd36e5af06d7a3790e30ce3f449fa89b853768/research/p104-unread-path-resynthesis/PROOF.md), [literal seven-event plan](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/05cd36e5af06d7a3790e30ce3f449fa89b853768/research/p104-unread-path-resynthesis/PLAN.json), [complete receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/05cd36e5af06d7a3790e30ce3f449fa89b853768/research/p104-unread-path-resynthesis/RESULT.json), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/05cd36e5af06d7a3790e30ce3f449fa89b853768/research/p104-unread-path-resynthesis/SOURCES.json), and [validation record](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/05cd36e5af06d7a3790e30ce3f449fa89b853768/research/p104-unread-path-resynthesis/VALIDATION.md).

The interval starts at event 13815 of exact PR5811 head `33d7760d0a6fea6394aefd014eea68f0af02a92e`. Role 695 reads role 733 before its update, moves directly from frame 3 to frame 1031, then reads role 773 before its reverse query. The old and new four-field transfer matrices agree for arbitrary entry values. Every public boundary, helper target and owned event remains fixed. The local paid delta is `-H1-H4+H5`, whose signed gain is positive for every concave power exponent between zero and one.

The full p16/a7 caller retains 18 forward calls, 15 thin queries and 3,120 whole idle jobs. It has **66,870 paid calls, 13,444 productive targets and rank surplus 760**. It retains 770 arbitrary public inputs, 29 owned labels, 31 lifetimes and peak 13 live owned fields. All COPY/CLEAR work, native maps, adapters, helper normalizers, scalars and routes are included. The local scalar allowance rises by eight to 225,046; the complete ordinary bound remains 184,647,552, below its 1,000,000,000 budget.

Two rational interval engines put the raw crossing inside `(0.00312476681507,0.00312476681508)`. The tested saving is `0.003124766805`. A strict derivative bound certifies the fixed-invoice crossing; it is not a global ceiling. Completion uses cutoff 16, floor 17, offset 1/7, power 1024, reserve 1e-12 and decay 125/128. All three tails, finite compiler conditions, 54 strict outer rows and four functional conditions pass.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-unread-path-resynthesis
```

Expected in each registered mode:

```text
PASS_P104_UNREAD_PATH_KAPPA_00312476680
```

Python 3.12 and the standard library suffice. Primary and registered normal/optimized replays pass: all 799 input coordinates and 638,401 coefficients, a separate dense transpose, 2,918 exact native maps and absolute phases, 1,124 helper normalizers, 208 main adapters, the physical caller and the full price/compiler calculation. Twelve word/source/caller/invoice controls reject, as do the native phase and retained bad-parameter controls.

The scientific commit `92e5b3dacbcadd585e68e6fc7b63665471513784` passed a separate read-only, Git-free `-I -O -B` replay with empty PATH in **136.953 seconds**. All 24 exported files, including the export manifest, kept their bytes and modes. Archive SHA256: `e09abfb69287950597fa024f68e256232929dc485d2119eae5bc10447fb22acc`. The publication commit changes only validation, overlap and attribution prose; runtime, mathematical inputs and receipts are unchanged. Final committed-byte/mode and official export/input checks pass. Full-history ancestry mode was not run in the shallow checkout. Hosted scientific CI and independent acceptance remain separate.

The branch starts from canonical main `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a`, priority 8, and adds only this package. The [canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5125#discussioncomment-19154639) records the distinct role-695 scope. Final overlap through 03:15 UTC covered 376 open PRs and 5,236 Discussion records with complete remote pagination; unpublished work remains a limit. The released role-92 construction and active mixed-payload, helper-retirement and variable-caller work are separate.

Credit Mason Hale for PR5811's exact composition and fourth accumulation; Ali Romman for the [PR #5802 accumulation source](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5802) and [PR #5796 second block](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5796); Joel Pulikkan for [PR #5739's R22 block](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5739); and Dugongue for [PR #5806's composition proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5806). The authenticated [PR #5786 closure](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5786) at `6b936acd68a7e0f9062037900f0fe9bc4b6fdd25` supplies the native, caller and compiler modules. [NOTICE](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/05cd36e5af06d7a3790e30ce3f449fa89b853768/research/p104-unread-path-resynthesis/NOTICE) retains the source notices and all earlier helper, native, controller, compiler, BIT and analytic credit. New fixed-interval construction and verification: Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0. The elementary linear identity is not claimed as a new theorem.

The five assumptions `native_all_columns`, `owned_erasure`, `compiler`, `precision_tape` and `analytic_recovery` remain. The large uniform word and rounded multiplier are not materialized. No independent human acceptance, merge, closure or selected-frontier update is claimed. Open next questions are an independent replay and a new helper/caller contract with a larger fully charged gain; bounded unsuccessful searches do not prove that such a gain is impossible.
